_comment: WhatsApp Bot (Baileys / @whiskeysockets/baileys) — universal egg for ANY Baileys-based WhatsApp bot. Auto-detects entry file. Supports interactive pairing-code flow on Pterodactyl.
name: WhatsApp Bot (Baileys)
author: Caltex254
description: Universal egg for ANY WhatsApp bot built on @whiskeysockets/baileys (formerly @adiwajshing/baileys). Auto-detects the entry file (index.ts/index.js/bot.ts/bot.js/app.ts/app.js/main.ts/main.js). Auto-installs @whiskeysockets/baileys and tsx if missing. Supports interactive phone-number pairing code flow on Pterodactyl — just set BOT_PHONE env var. Works with WhatsApp Multi-Device API. Compatible with popular Baileys bot frameworks like WhiskeySockets/Baileys-MD, wabot-md, aquaxv, etc.

installation.script:
#!/bin/sh
set -e
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server
if [ ! -f whatsapp-baileys-start.sh ]; then
    cat > whatsapp-baileys-start.sh <<'STARTSH'
#!/bin/sh
echo '[install] Placeholder.'
STARTSH
fi
chmod +x whatsapp-baileys-start.sh
mkdir -p /mnt/server/auth_info_baileys
echo '[install] WhatsApp Bot (Baileys) egg ready.'

variables.name: Bot Phone Number (pairing)
variables.description: Phone number to generate a WhatsApp pairing code, international format without + or spaces (e.g. 254712345678). Used by the bot on first start to display a pairing code in the console.

variables.name: Bot Owner Phone (permissions)
variables.description: Phone number of the bot owner (used for owner-only commands). Same format as BOT_PHONE. If BOT_PHONE is blank, this is also used as the pairing phone.

variables.name: Command Prefix
variables.description: Prefix for bot commands. Use '.' for .menu, .ping etc. Other common values: '!', '/', '#'.

variables.name: Bot Name
variables.description: Display name for the bot (shown in WhatsApp as the linked device name).

variables.name: Session ID (optional)
variables.description: Optional session identifier (used by some bot frameworks for credential storage). Defaults to 'default'.

variables.name: Startup File (optional)
variables.description: Override the auto-detected entry file. E.g. 'src/bot.ts'. Leave blank to auto-detect.

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: Pino/winston log level. Use 'warn' or 'error' for production, 'debug' for troubleshooting.

variables.name: Max Restart Retries
variables.description: Number of times to auto-restart on crash before giving up.

variables.name: Base Restart Delay (seconds)
variables.description: Initial delay between restart attempts. Doubles on each retry, capped at 300s.
